> ⚠️ **交付物先是一次读数**:卡面写明修法是「两种形状之间的选择,而那**需要它自己的一次读数**」⇒ 认领者**先量**(哪些已存过滤器落在这对歧义 token 上),再定形状。⛔ 不是先挑形状。

So: measure which stored filters land on the ambiguous pair, and measure the consequence the card explicitly did **not** measure. Only then argue a shape.

### The consequence the card hands you as UNMEASURED

The card quotes `filter-builder.tsx`'s own docblock — an operator the dropdown no longer lists *"rendered as a BLANK trigger"* (objectui#4768) — and then says, verbatim: *"I did not drive that render, so treat it as the documented behaviour of the component rather than as a measurement of this route. Whoever takes this should confirm it first — it decides whether this is cosmetic drift or a control the author cannot read."*

⇒ **Drive it.** A blank trigger and a trigger that silently reads `greaterThan` are two different harms with two different prices, and nobody here knows which one ships.

## The three shapes — two of them are fenced, and the fence is not mine

⛔ I am **not** picking B for you. I am telling you which shapes you cannot land from this card, so your measurement is spent on the one you can:

- **A — give `after` / `before` their own tokens.** ⛔ Blocked. objectui#9306 (the open decision on filter-builder's two operator vocabularies) is **open, `pm:queue`, `priority:p3`** as of this claim — I read its state in this act. The card says direction A "is not takeable before it is ruled". It has not been ruled.
- **B — make `MONGO_TO_OP` field-type-aware.** Costs `conditionToGroup` a `fields` argument. Implementable in this lane.
- **C — add `greaterThan` / `lessThan` to the date bucket.** ⛔ Different package. The card: *"Changes what the dropdown offers on dates, which is `@object-ui/components`' call rather than this inspector's."* If your measurement points here, **stop and report** — do not cross the package boundary from this card.

If the measurement says B is wrong, that is a **full success**: report it and stop. A card that returns a reading and a refusal is worth more than a card that returns the wrong shape.

## Clause-②: `no` — measured in this act, not reasoned about

`conditionToGroup` is `export`ed from its own module (`:187`), which is exactly the shape that has burned this lane before — ⭐ *"not named in the package entry" is not the same as "not on the published face"*. So I measured the entry rather than assuming:

| probe | reading |
|---|---|
| SUBJECT — `conditionToGroup` / `datasetFilterCondition` named in `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` | **0 hits** |
| CONTROL — the entry is not empty | **84** `^export` lines |
| CONTROL — metadata-admin leaves that ARE re-exported | 25 of them, enumerated by name at `:371`–`:428`; `inspectors/datasetFilterCondition.js` is **absent** from that list |

⇒ adding a parameter to `conditionToGroup` moves no published signature. ⚠️ **Re-measure at delivery and return it as a `clause_2` field**; mechanical floor `^\+export` = 0 plus "no new key on a published payload". If your shape reaches `@object-ui/components`' operator buckets, clause ② flips ⇒ stop and report.

## ⛔ Hard constraints

- ⛔ **Not objectui#9372's or objectui#9363's territory.** Those two rule the WRITE half in the same file. This is the READ half. Same file is not the same card — triage says so in as many words: *"**同文件不等于同卡**"*.
- ⛔ **Do not reopen or extend objectui#9306.** If you find yourself needing its ruling, that is the stop signal, not an invitation.
- ⛔ objectui `AGENTS.md:316`: never `git push --force` or `--force-with-lease`, never push to `main`. Absolute, and ⛔ **not** tiered by seat — a single-author feature branch is no exception.
- ⚠️ Scope-pinned card ⇒ AGENTS.md #11's opportunistic citation repair does **not** apply.

## The pin

It must **fail on the pre-fix tree**, through the round trip rather than on a lookup table: build a filter the way an author builds it (operator `after` on a date column), store it, read it back, and assert the operator the date bucket actually offers. ⛔ A pin that only asserts the fixed mapping is half a measurement — this lane has paid for that twice, once on a pin whose assertion could not fail and once on an equality where two absences compared equal.

⭐ The card's own control is the model: `greaterThan` IS a real member of the number bucket, so the `false` on the date bucket is a reading about dates specifically and not a lookup that answers `false` for everything. Keep that control lit in your pin.

## Serial constraints cleared

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/` — I read the changed-file list of **all 9 open PRs** in this act (objectui#9762, objectui#9592, objectui#9584, objectui#9540, objectui#9488, objectui#9391, objectui#9378, objectui#8941, objectui#5400). **None** touches `metadata-admin`. ⇒ none.

## Return

The stored-filter census, the driven render (blank trigger or silent wrong operator), which shape your reading points at and why, the pin failing on the pre-fix tree, the `clause_2` field, and any premise of mine you falsified. ⚠️ Twelve of my premises have been falsified by lanes in the last four shifts — treat every line number and count above as mine to be checked, not given. **A clean stop is a full success.**

A plain re-open writes nothing back (0 `onChange` calls), so the stored filter survives being looked at but not being edited. ⇒ triage's question is answered: **a control the author cannot read**, not cosmetic drift.

## Both fences held, and one of them turned out to be doubled

- **A** (own tokens) — not taken. objectui#9306 re-read at delivery: still open, `pm:queue`, `priority:p3`. ⭐ And independently found to be fenced **twice**: the spec's `FILTER_OPERATORS` carries no `$after` and no `$before` at all, so A is not an objectui change — it needs a vocabulary change in `@objectstack/spec`, another repo.
- **C** (add `greaterThan`/`lessThan` to the date bucket) — not taken, and the measurement argues against it on the merits: it does not end the collapse, it only makes the wrong answer a **listed** one, converting the harm into the silently-wrong-operator variant, which is the worse of the two.

## The implementation, read line by line

✅ `MONGO_PREIMAGE` is **derived** from `OP_TO_MONGO` in an IIFE rather than hand-listed — the second copy is what makes the two halves drift, and there isn't one. ✅ `readBackOperator` **asks** `operatorsForFieldType` rather than copying the bucket table, so its answer cannot disagree with what the dropdown lists. ✅ The `fields` parameter is **optional**, and omitting it restores the unchanged fixed-table read, so the three sibling pins that call `conditionToGroup` with no field list pass untouched and exercise the fallback arm. ✅ Nothing new is accepted, the write half is untouched, and no stored filter is rewritten — only the operator id the panel is seeded with, and it changes to one the panel can draw.

⭐ The argument from the file's own design is the part I would have missed: **four** tokens have two operators writing them — `$exists`, `$null`, `$gt`, `$lt` — and the first two are *already* disambiguated here, by their payload boolean. `$gt`/`$lt` carry the author's comparand instead, so the field type is the only disambiguator left. That is a reading about this file, not a preference.

Restore proven by an empty `git diff HEAD`, ⛔ not by an exit code. And no `dist` is in the path — vitest aliases both `@object-ui/components` and the bridge to source, so the ablation could not read a stale build.
